claims: Rory McIlroy is scheduled to tee off in the final round of the 2026 Masters Tournament on Sunday, April 12, at 2:25 p.m. ET.
Rory McIlroy will be playing in the final pairing with Cameron Young.
Rory McIlroy and Cameron Young are tied for the lead at 11-under par going into the final round of the 2026 Masters Tournament.
The 2026 Masters Tournament is at Augusta National Golf Club.
Coverage of Round 4 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is available on CBS and Paramount+.
